scripts.version: changeset version && bun packages/cli/script/version.ts && bun install
scripts.check:extension: cd extension && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run check && bun run build
scripts.check: bun run check:extension && cargo +stable fmt --all -- --check && cargo +stable clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -j 2 -- -D warnings && cargo +stable test --workspace --locked -j 2 && cargo +stable deny check
